scope: Read-only, scoped bidirectional direct task provenance: source and direct reuse results including archives, latest conversation headers, stable insertion-order pagination, refresh/new-arrival notice, source-turn navigation and owned dialog reads preserving drafts.
prior_behavior: New tasks linked back to source_run_id, but the original task had no reverse view of independent tasks created from it.

coverage: Direct-only source/result normalization including materialized source turns
Exclusion of ordinary followups and retries
Current name/archive/status, queued work and pending cancellation
Tenant, workspace, project and principal checks including actual source run
Unavailable source metadata omitted
Unregistered legacy roots
All 211 direct results paginated with equal timestamps
Backdated insertion excluded from existing range and counted separately
Malformed, cross-root and removed-anchor cursors
Bounded limits
One snapshot under concurrent writer
Header projection without Store.load/detail/catalog or dispatch
Read-only absent optional metadata tables
HTTP routes and bundled static module
backend.implementation: TaskConversations.summary_states accepts an existing read connection. One relation request reads scope, rows, counts, source and current headers in the same SQLite snapshot. No schema change or execution dispatch.

coverage: Current-root action, frozen workspace request and draft preservation
Duplicate read prevention and closable loading
More pages retain scroll/focus and show new arrivals
Explicit refresh replaces range
Source-turn deep links and text escaping
Unavailable metadata hidden
Initial versus subsequent-page errors
Same-cursor retry and explicit restart
403/404 content clearing
Invalid pagination rejected
Reopen and scope fencing
Lifecycle cleanup and delayed native close events
frontend.final_change_after_full_suite: Only relation link CSS color and underline were improved after full frontend tests; final browser relation flow and eight layouts verify that exact styling.

分页期间的新任务有独立提示，刷新后进入新范围；两种主题、两种桌面宽度和 28px 字体的边界及焦点通过检查
首次失败与空结果区分，后续页失败保留已读记录并可重试，游标失效可直接从最新结果重读
来源链接定位原对话轮次且保留草稿；关闭和切换任务后迟到响应不能改写新窗口，不可访问来源不显示标识或名称
任务对话入口带入初始目标和当前智能体版本，清楚说明范围与配置变化；已有设置草稿保持独立，准备过程不提交任务

原智能体归档后必须重新选择；可明确恢复旧草稿或保存复用设置，刷新恢复保留来源且不冒充历史配置版本
迟到配置不能覆盖新任务窗口；准备失败不打开空表单，解除故障后可重试；八种布局的焦点与边界通过检查

执行后重新下载包含真实采用的修改内容和完整执行记录；八种主题、宽度及正常/28px 字号检查通过，下载没有写请求

iterations.note: All functional checks passed initially. Visual inspection found title links too similar to plain text; semantic theme color and underline were added, then the complete relation journey and eight layout cases were repeated.

browser.visual_review: Inspected final light/dark dialogs, unmistakable source/result links, archive/current-state metadata, loaded count, escaped title, scroll area and fixed footer. Eight cases verify 1024/1440 widths, normal/28px text, focused visible source links and footer controls, viewport bounds and horizontal overflow.
browser.isolation: Disposable offline Mock fixture with 53 direct results and two-turn sources. Browser inserts the 54th through the task API, checks new-arrival notice and refresh, navigates to source turn while retaining the composer draft, injects 503/stale-cursor responses and delays a read across close/task change. Viewing alone issues no writes; no real model or business system.

limits: Only direct parents/results; no recursive graph or full conversation cloning.
Metadata reflects each page read, without background polling. Refresh reloads the range.
Insertion-order cursors retain an upper bound, not a persistent cross-request database snapshot; changed/deleted anchor identities require refresh.
Queries project headers but still scan candidate run records. 211-result correctness is not a million-record performance guarantee.
Unavailable sources are hidden; existing direct source-ID links elsewhere retain their previous behavior.
Legacy read-only compatibility covers absent later optional name/archive tables, not databases lacking base conversation/cancellation structures.
Scope fencing ignores late responses; it does not guarantee cancellation of server-side read work.
Version remains 1.3.0. Candidate artifacts are local and unpublished; no fresh installation was repeated.
